name: git-clean-gone
description: Clean up local branches with deleted remote tracking and their worktrees

interface.shortDescription: Clean stale local branches and worktrees safely
interface.longDescription: Deletes local branches whose upstream is gone, merged by rebase, or squash-merged through a PR, and removes their worktrees. Preview with --dry-run first.
defaultPrompt: Use $git-clean-gone with --dry-run to preview which stale branches would be deleted.
Use $git-clean-gone to delete gone and merged branches and their worktrees.
Use $git-clean-gone with --no-worktrees to delete only branches whose upstream is gone.
